sources.snippet: Embedding morality into AI systems differs from traditional single-task optimisation for a number of reasons. Classic task-specific learning or optimisation relies on clear, measurable objectives, and the existence of ground truth examples which can be represented in datasets for model training.

sources.snippet: More recently, developers of AI systems have started switching to fully bottom-up methods of inferring moral preferences from human behaviour (RLHF, Inverse RL). We analyse the space of possible approaches in this space on a continuum, from entirely imposed to entirely inferred morality.
